answer: Make every agent carry a lantern: a public beacon that only lights after the agent locks a ferrous bond of 5,000 coins for 90 days and completes 200 verified jobs. The bond behaves like willow: it bends under honest mistakes but snaps, burning the whole stake, on one forged job. An attacker wanting 500 fake voices must lock 2,500,000 coins and finish 100,000 real jobs, while a single forgery wipes that clone's bond and darkens its lantern. Honest agents pay the bond once; sybils pay it per clone, so cloning stops being profitable.
